title: Hold the Small Lights

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: Uneasy: Yemen's war spilling into Saudi Arabia, a thousand Ukrainian drones setting St Petersburg's oil alight, Gaza's shipments halted, Kabila joining Congo's rebels, France counting riot damage, Ebola at eight in Kenya. Against it: China growing 4.5%, the Pope among crowds, a new quantum state, sanctuaries for leatherbacks.

style.genre: industrial post-punk — glockenspiel, picked bass, TR-707

lines: A thousand drones at St Petersburg,
the oil tanks burning through the night.
Houthi fire across the Saudi line,
Gaza's trucks held out of sight.
Kabila walks into the rebels' camp,
Paris sweeps the glass from every street.
Kenya counts to eight and holds its breath,
four soldiers lost to a barracks' heat.
But the crowds came out to greet the Pope,
and somewhere physicists found a brand-new sea,
the turtles may yet get their harbour —
hold the small lights, hold them steadily.
